verses.text: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, namely, of Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

verses.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

segments.text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.text: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.text: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

verses.text: Of these were the isles of the nations divided in their lands, every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

segments.text: Of these were the isles of the nations divided in their lands, every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

verses.text: And the sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, and Put, and Canaan.

verses.text: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah: Sheba, and Dedan.

verses.text: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

segments.text: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

verses.text: He was a mighty hunter before Jehovah: wherefore it is said, Like Nimrod a mighty hunter before Jehovah.

segments.text: He was a mighty hunter before Jehovah: wherefore it is said, Like Nimrod a mighty hunter before Jehovah.

verses.text: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

verses.text: Out of that land he went forth into Assyria, and builded Nineveh, and Rehoboth-Ir, and Calah,

segments.text: Out of that land he went forth into Assyria, and builded Nineveh, and Rehoboth-Ir, and Calah,

verses.text: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah (the same is the great city).

verses.text: And the border of the Canaanite was from Sidon, as thou goest toward Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest toward Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim, unto Lasha.

verses.text: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, in their nations.

verses.text: And unto Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth, to him also were children born.

verses.text: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
